about: Run exactly one subagent in the background (do not wait for it) whose whole task is to reply with a marker, then end your turn at once. A subagent left running in the background reports after the turn that started it; the harness runs a turn of its own on the report, or takes it into the turn still running.

children.reason: The SDK keeps no store for a subagent; its only record is the plain transcript Cursor writes under ~/.cursor/projects, which the recorder doesn't keep with the pair.
